coverage.note: Mississippi: the Legislature's bill-status record lists Code sections in a zero-padded form. A section brought forward (`BF`) or reenacted (`R`) is listed as `other`: the act named it and did not necessarily change it. Entries the publisher prints as a list or range (`338-15, 21`), with a subsection pincite, or by an act's own section number are not matched, so a section can be amended by an act this answer does not list.
